notes: Encoded ONLY from this brand's own page. Page states parent Nortek (formerly Nordyne Manufacturing). The page's sister/similar list (AirBloc, Ambirad, Benson, Broan, Frigidaire, Gibson, Intertherm, Kelvinator, Mammoth, Miller, Nordyne, NuTone, Philco, Reznor, Tappan, Ventrol, Westinghouse) is not claimed as shared-system reuse: both styles below are stated on this page itself, and nothing is imported from the Nordyne or Intertherm files, even though the examples coincide with Intertherm's page.

styles.notes: Page: year = 4th & 5th numerical digits, month = 6th & 7th numerical digits. Character counting: year = normalized [3,5] = '03' -> 2003, month = [5,7] = '03' -> March. Digit-only counting is falsified on this page's own example: it would give year '31' (1931 below floor / 2031 future, no valid resolution). The two page images (MAYTAG-1.jpg) are annotated serial diagrams, not month tables; month is text-verified digits, so no image-pass hold.

styles.era: 12-character serials (normalized), letter + digit + letter + 9 digits, year + month
styles.notes: Page: year = 4th & 5th digits, month = 6th & 7th digits. Character counting on the normalized serial (dash stripped): year = [3,5] = '99' -> 1999, month = [5,7] = '05' -> May. Digit-only counting is falsified: it would give month '50', invalid. Serial as printed: G6R9905-05028. Pattern is disjoint from style-1 (digit at position 2 vs letter), so no shape collision.
